title: Urgent need to revise the medical devices regulation
part_text: 1.Callson the Commission to propose, by the end of Q1 2025, delegated and implementing acts and targeted amendments to the MDR and the IVDR to address the most pressing challenges and bottlenecks in the implementation of the legislative frameworks and to propose the systematic revision of all relevant articles of these regulations, accompanied by an impact assessment, to be conducted as soon as possible and by the end of Q3 2025 at the latest;
